info.name: OrderSphere - Full Order Flow
info.description:
End-to-end test collection spanning auth-service, inventory-service, ordersphere-orders, payment-service, shipping-service, and notification-service. Requires the full stack running (docker-compose up). Routes through the API Gateway (http://localhost:8080) using Spring Cloud Gateway's discovery-locator convention (/{service-id}/...).

Payment works like a real hosted checkout: placing an order returns a checkoutUrl on the dummy payment gateway (http://localhost:8087), and the 'Pay ...' / 'Cancel on Checkout Page' requests submit that page's form exactly as a browser would (test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 succeeds, 4000 0000 0000 0002 is declined). Redirects are not followed, so the Web UI doesn't need to be running.

Run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner or newman (`npx newman run postman/full-order-flow.postman_collection.json`). Every request has assertions. Steps marked [poll] or [expect ...] on async state (payment settlement, shipment progression, notification delivery - all ~5s sweeps) re-run themselves every 3s (up to 20 times) until the expected state shows up. When sending requests one by one by hand, just re-send those until their test passes.

Each run creates a fresh product SKU, so stock checks are exact and re-runs don't interfere.
